text:
GENERATE BURST K1p-paint-idle-S — gear paint-over of an animation sheet (Run C-3 P5, fork C: the advanced set on the same woman, motion identical). task_id "K1p-paint-idle-S".

Image 1 is an ANIMATION SHEET: 16 cells, each one frame of ONE relaxed idle (breathing), facing the camera of the same young woman, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, on a flat #00ff00 plate. Image 2 shows the SAME woman wearing the ADVANCED gear set: a small brass ASTROLABE (nested open rings + pointer arm) at the tip of her walnut staff, and a chestnut-leather PAULDRON with brass edging on her LEFT shoulder carrying Image 3's emblem (a needle through three stacked bands) as a small brass plate. EDIT Image 1 — do not redraw it: in EVERY cell, and identically in every cell, (1) replace the plain brass tip of the staff with Image 2's astrolabe, following the staff's position in that cell; (2) add Image 2's pauldron on her LEFT shoulder, following that shoulder in that cell. She faces the camera, so her LEFT shoulder is on the SCREEN-RIGHT side of her body; the staff is in her right hand on screen-left. CHANGE NOTHING ELSE: every cell keeps its exact pose, size, position, face, hair, costume, colours, line and the #00ff00 plate; the cell layout, spacing and frame order stay exactly as Image 1; no new objects, no glow, no text, no borders. Output the whole sheet at Image 1's size (1024×1536).

One image_gen call in EDIT mode on Image 1. ONE retry only if cells are rearranged, a cell is missing, the pauldron lands on her right shoulder, or the plate changes — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/sheet_idle_S_advanced.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-paint-idle-S"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the animation sheet to EDIT
IMAGE 2 — the advanced gear on the same woman (gear appearance only)
